WITH telescope_observatory AS (
  SELECT 
    t.observstation,
    o.lunarstage,
    t.bandusagepct
  FROM telescopes t
  INNER JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
),
all_station_phases AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT observstation, lunarstage
  FROM telescope_observatory
),
station_bandwidth_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    observstation,
    lunarstage,
    AVG(bandusagepct) AS station_avg_bw
  FROM telescope_observatory
  WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY observstation, lunarstage
),
phase_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    asp.lunarstage,
    AVG(sba.station_avg_bw) AS avg_bandwidth_usage,
    COUNT(DISTINCT asp.observstation) AS station_count
  FROM all_station_phases asp
  LEFT JOIN station_bandwidth_avg sba 
    ON asp.observstation = sba.observstation AND asp.lunarstage = sba.lunarstage
  GROUP BY asp.lunarstage
)
SELECT 
  p.lunarstage AS phase,
  p.avg_bandwidth_usage,
  p.station_count,
  CAST(p.station_count AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(station_count) FROM phase_stats) AS fraction_of_total
FROM phase_stats p
ORDER BY p.lunarstage

assumptions.assumption: All observstations are counted per phase, including those with no non-NULL bandwidth values; only non-NULL bandwidth values contribute to the phase average.

alternatives.interpretation: Count only observstations that have at least one telescope with non-NULL bandwidth in that phase (exclude observstations where all telescopes have NULL bandwidth).
